checks.lead: Sanada Yukimura (真田  幸村; 1567 – June 3, 1615), was a Japanese samurai warrior of the Sengoku period also known as Sanada Nobushige (真田 信繁) the give name by Takeda Shingen from the name of Shingen's younger brother, Takeda Nobushige, who was a brave and honorable soldier. He was especially known as the leading general on the defending side of the Siege of Osaka. Yukimura was called "Crimson Demon of War" and "The Last Sengoku Hero". Toyotomi Hideyoshi called him "A Hero who may appear once in a hundred years", also the famed veteran of the invasion of Korea, Shimazu Tadatsune, called him the "Number one warrior in Japan" (日本一の兵).
